sentence: She decided to go the extra mile to impress her boss
explanation: 'Go the extra mile' significa hacer más esfuerzo del esperado. 'Decided to' + forma base.

sentence: He has been sitting on the fence about the job offer
explanation: 'Sit on the fence' significa evitar tomar una decisión. Presente perfecto continuo para una indecisión que persiste.

sentence: If you burn the candle at both ends you will get sick
hint: First conditional: If + present, will + base form
explanation: 'Burn the candle at both ends' significa trabajar en exceso. Primer condicional para una posibilidad real.

sentence: The manager told us to think outside the box
explanation: 'Think outside the box' significa pensar de forma creativa. 'Told us to' + forma base.

sentence: We should not cry over spilt milk about the lost contract
explanation: 'Cry over spilt milk' significa lamentarse por algo que no se puede cambiar.

sentence: They were killing two birds with one stone by combining the trips
explanation: 'Kill two birds with one stone' significa lograr dos cosas con una sola acción. 'By' + gerundio explica cómo.

sentence: I would not touch that topic with a ten foot pole
hint: Would not + base form for hypothetical refusal
explanation: 'Touch with a ten foot pole' significa evitar por completo. 'Would not' para situaciones hipotéticas.

sentence: She let the cat out of the bag about the surprise party
explanation: 'Let the cat out of the bag' significa revelar un secreto. El pasado de 'let' es 'let' (irregular).

sentence: The new employee is learning the ropes very quickly
explanation: 'Learn the ropes' significa aprender cómo funcionan las cosas. Presente continuo para una acción actual.

sentence: If we play our cards right we could get the promotion
hint: Conditional: If + present, could + base form
explanation: 'Play your cards right' significa actuar con inteligencia. Condicional mixto con 'could' para expresar posibilidad.

sentence: After the failure we went back to the drawing board
explanation: 'Back to the drawing board' significa volver a planificar algo desde el principio después de un fracaso.

sentence: I cannot remember the number off the top of my head
explanation: 'Off the top of my head' significa decir algo de memoria sin verificar los datos.

sentence: These complaints are just the tip of the iceberg
explanation: 'The tip of the iceberg' significa una parte pequeña y visible de un problema mucho mayor.

sentence: It took a while but I finally got the hang of it
explanation: 'Get the hang of it' significa aprender a hacer algo.

sentence: To make a long story short we missed the flight
explanation: 'To make a long story short' se usa para resumir algo rápidamente.
